name: codex-kit
description: Delegate work to OpenAI's Codex CLI from Claude Code, with independent verification instead of blind trust: native and adversarial code review, task rescue with diff double-check, document/plan verification, cross-model research, job/session management, an optional stop-time quality gate, and a generic reviewer-agnostic bridge for CI/audit use cases including this repository's own PR pipeline. Bundles its own Codex engine — replaces OpenAI's official codex plugin rather than depending on it.
